texts.preamble: S.Sekar vs The Commissioner on 20 June, 2025 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 20.06.2025 Coram The Honourable Mrs Justice N. Mala W.P No. 21656 of 2025 S.Sekar ... Pet Vs 1. The Commissioner, Corporation of Chennai, Rippon Buildings, P.H. Road, Vepery, Chennai-3. 2.The Food Safety Commissioner, Dms Buildings, 359, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai-6. 3.Revenue Officer, Zone-5, Corporation of Chennai, 9 Chidambaram, 7th Street, Chidambaram Nagar, Basin Bridge, Chennai-1. 4.The Executive Officer, Egambraeshwarar Temple, Thanga Salai, Mint Chennai-600 003. ....
texts.arguments: 2. When the matter is came up for hearing before this court, the learned counsel for the 3rd respondent submitted that the petitioner is a encroacher and that proceedings under Section 78 of the HR & CE Act, were invoked for eviction of the petitioner. The learned counsel on instructions submits that orders in proceedings under Section 78 of the Act were passed on 18.06.2025, for eviction of the petitioner and the subtenant, one Saraswathi.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. When the matter is came up for hearing before this court, the learned counsel for the 3rd respondent submitted that the petitioner is a encroacher and that proceedings under Section 78 of the HR & CE Act, were invoked for eviction of the petitioner. The learned counsel on instructions submits that orders in proceedings under Section 78 of the Act were passed on 18.06.2025, for eviction of the petitioner and the subtenant, one Saraswathi.
